item.title: Israeli Consulate pulls funding for Atlanta Jewish Film Festival over juror’s social media posts
item.description: The Consulate General of Israel to the Southeastern United States announced that it will end its partnership and financial support of the Atlanta Jewish Film Festival over a juror’s views on the state of Israel and the war in Gaza posted to social media. item.title: Police: 1 dead, 2 seriously injured in ‘targeted’ shooting in DeKalb
item.description: Police are investigating a shooting in DeKalb that left several victims wounded and caused traffic delays, with the investigation still ongoing and a search for a suspect underway. item.title: Six food businesses become part of container courtyard at Pittsburgh Yards in Southwest Atlanta
item.description: Pittsburgh Yards has placed its final shipping container for its outdoor business courtyard, which features eleven retail and restaurant businesses, including coffee shop Urban Grind Brew Box, The Creamy Spot ice cream, and vegan hot dog stand Carrot Dog. item.title: Dunwoody police mourn the passing of longtime veteran William ‘Rusty’ Furman
item.description: Major William "Rusty" Furman, one of the original officers of the Dunwoody Police Department, passed away after a battle with cancer, leaving behind a legacy of leadership, mentorship, and service.
